name: Silent Mainland
description:
About This Game

Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder built around movement and grid mechanics, focused on strategy and combat, inspired by Slay the Spire and Monster Train. Build a unique deck in every run to challenge powerful foes, collect relics, and execute devastating combos across a procedurally generated continent. A must-play for fans of deckbuilding and Roguelike strategy!

Game Features

Spatial-Driven Strategy

  • Movement on the 5x12 grid is more than just positioning; it is the core engine for triggering card synergies. By integrating character displacement with spatial tactics, the game redefines the strategic depth of traditional deckbuilding.

Cycle of Day and Night

  • The battlefield cycles between Day and Night as turns unfold, and each time of day comes with its own distinct battlefield rules.

  • Harness the rhythm of this day-night cycle to shape your offensive and defensive tempo.

Battlefront Depth & Relentless Waves

  • Faced with endless waves of monsters pouring onto the battlefield, use the depth of the grid to pull enemies back and set up defenses. Amid unrelenting pressure, seize the perfect moment to strike back.

  • Game progression has evolved from classic linear path exploration to large-scale global campaign mode, delivering tighter pacing and more satisfying combat.

Multidimensional Card Evolution

  • In-game card upgrades offer diverse paths: Augmentation, Generalization, and Empowerment. Based on your evolutionary choices, every run allows for the development of entirely distinct archetypes and strategic synergies.

Content Included

  • 4 unique mercenaries: Dynamic Knight, Elemental Mage, Howling Druid, Sorrow Assassin

  • 350+ cards.

  • 130+ relics.

  • 50+ items.

  • 30+ events—challenge yourself or take a gamble!

Game Background

A group of adventurers brought together by life's low points forms a mercenary group to embark on a treasure hunt in the "Silent Mainland". They overcome powerful enemies in a perilous journey and ultimately gain not only treasures but also the courage to face adversities, the faith to rediscover themselves, and the precious bonds between each other.

We hope you enjoy playing "Silent Mainland" and love the game!

If you do, please consider adding it to your Wishlist—it means a lot to us.
short_desc: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.
